cohort: 1,051 postpartum women who delivered their offspring at 15 institutions around Tokyo from October 2021 to March 2022
finding: mRNA vaccines did not appear to have adverse effects on short-term perinatal outcomes and may have prevented SARS-CoV-2 infection or reduced COVID-19 severity in pregnant women.
mod_finding: The cesarean section rate was 33.2% in the vaccinated group and 42.2% in the unvaccinated group.
